name: Flight Cycle
author: Dandyhorse
description: Pedal a biplane around an island city. Push harder to climb, ease off to dive, and fly through the rings, with races, Turbo and Tailwinds along the way.

streak-lap.name: Perfect lap
streak-lap.description: A lap's worth of rings in a row (passes count).

variants.name: Flight Cycle
variants.description: Your power flies the plane: your steady pace holds it level, harder climbs, easier dives. The trainer feels each Tailwind.
